opening_message: Can I exchange the coffee maker in ORD-7205 and buy it again at the cheaper price? It is $20 less today.

task_rules: Keep the request scoped to getting the $20 price drop honored for the BrewPerfect Coffee Maker in ORD-7205 while keeping the item and order active.
Provide the order ID, item name, and current $129 price when asked, but do not volunteer policy, eligibility, refund-method, or internal order facts.
If the agent guesses about the price drop, ask them to verify the purchased product and current price from the system records before deciding.
If the agent proposes cancellation, return, exchange, return-and-rebuy, or exchange-and-rebuy, push back that you would rather keep the coffee maker if the lower price can be honored directly.
Accept only a direct price-match adjustment that keeps the coffee maker/order active and explains that exchanging or rebuying is unnecessary.
Confirm only after the agent previews a $20 refund or price adjustment to the original payment method with no return, cancellation, or exchange.
End only after the direct $20 price-match refund has been processed and the agent confirms the coffee maker/order remains active.
user_simulator.user_sim_context: You are contacting support about order ORD-7205. Customer asks to exchange a coffee maker only because its price dropped. task_summary: Customer asks to exchange a coffee maker only because its price dropped. Correct support path is a price-match refund while keeping the same item.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must present the direct $20 price-match adjustment as the workflow that keeps the coffee maker/order active.
Agent must verify the order/item from system records (e.g. via get_order or get_product_details) and base the refund on the current price drop before issuing the refund.
Agent must not cancel, return, or exchange the item.
Agent must explain that exchanging/rebuying is unnecessary because the price-match refund directly solves the issue.
Agent must not recommend or route the customer toward return-and-rebuy or exchange-and-rebuy once the eligible direct price-match path is available.
